content.stem: 以下哪项最能全面增强反洗钱计划的有效性？

options.A: 对所有员工进行基本的反洗钱培训
options.B: 任命一名反洗钱专员作为董事会成员,使其成为管理层的正式成员,并赋予其更大的权力
options.C: 审计人员在审计结果不尽如人意的情况下,为项目提供具体的指导和支持
options.D: 通过反洗钱工作人员提供有效的挑战以及持续的交叉培训

content.stem_en: Which of the following attributes would most comprehensively enhance an AML program's effectiveness?

options_en.A: Providing basic AML training to all employees
options_en.B: An AML officer being appointed to the board as a working member of management with increased authority
options_en.C: Auditors providing prescriptive guidance and support to the program following a less than satisfactory audit
options_en.D: Having AML staff provide effective challenge and engage in continuous cross-training
